title: Brigade coupons
description: Redeemable codes that grant brigade credits, Roar TEST coins, or both. Each entry holds the SHA-256 of the code (trimmed, case-sensitive), never the code. Client-side and trust-based until a server ledger exists (GH-205): a hash of a short code can be brute-forced offline. Several entries may share one hash (one code, several grants): each is redeemed once per account on its own id.
